title: Hierarchy Menu Item
description: A single node in a Hierarchy Menu. Child items are managed by DC's hierarchy tree UI — no inline children array. Renders using the same MenuItem component as the array-based MenuItem content type.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display text for this menu item.

link.title: Link
link.description: URL this item navigates to. Omit for parent-only category labels.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Optional icon from the design system's icon set, shown alongside the label.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Restrict this item to a single breakpoint. Leave unset to show it at all breakpoints.
